patterns.name: unsigned-service-install
patterns.condition: New or modified unsigned service with temporary executable path, or repeated unsigned registrations
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1543: Create or Modify System Process; unsigned service installation or binary replacement

patterns.name: suspicious-scheduled-task
patterns.condition: Unknown, randomly named or after-hours scheduled task launching a temporary executable
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1053: Scheduled Task/Job persistence and execution

patterns.name: unlisted-startup-entry
patterns.condition: New unlisted startup-folder executable, or unlisted reboot-persistent service in a temporary directory
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1547.001: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder; T1543: service persistence

patterns.name: combined-autostart
patterns.condition: Startup program and scheduled task launch the same temporary file
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1053 and T1547.001: overlapping scheduled and startup persistence

patterns.name: persistence-review
patterns.condition: Unverified service, task, temporary executable or startup alteration lacking combined proof of malicious persistence
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1543 and T1053: a single anomaly needs confirmation before isolation
